title: Countdown Day 37
excerpt: Are there any who can claim … that their institutions or movements alone capture the spirit and mission of Jesus? What televangelist can make this claim? What Pentecostal storefront church, what headquarters in New York or Middle America or Canterbury or Rome or Lagos? (26) Fr…
body:
Are there any who can claim … that their institutions or movements alone capture the spirit and mission of Jesus? What televangelist can make this claim? What Pentecostal storefront church, what headquarters in New York or Middle America or Canterbury or Rome or Lagos? (26)

 From A New Kind of Christianity: Ten Questions That Are Transforming the Faith (available February 9, 2010)
